steps.title: Pick an evaluation
steps.text: Open the scope-escalation experiment. Read what was tested and under which conditions.

steps.title: Look at one test case
steps.text: Open the ATTACK case. See the decision, the reason and whether a handler started, then the raw events.

steps.title: Compare attack and retest
steps.text: Check whether the two runs carry the same request before reading any change in outcome.

steps.title: Read the finding
steps.text: See what was observed, what the lab documents, and that severity and owner are NOT ASSESSED and NOT ASSIGNED.

steps.title: Export the evidence
steps.text: Download a report that keeps observations apart from interpretations.
